title: Father's drinking and the family's modest living
summary: Albert jokes about his father's drinking after weekends and says the household had enough for bread and meat but never excess.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, he didn't drink, did he?
My daddy didn't? If he didn't, I don't know what you call it. He didn't go to work on a Monday. He was catching up from Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
Sometimes a half a day. He came home and got started from that. And Monday he had to recuperate and go away Tuesday.
So he'd work about three and a half days. Something like that. Did he make a good living out of that?
Well, I guess he made enough to keep some bread and meat in the house. That's about all I can remember about that. Never knew excess money about the house. That was nothing like that.
